newsitem.title: ITALY: Italians feared dead, injured in railway accident.
newsitem.headline: Italians feared dead, injured in railway accident.

text.p: Four people were killed and several injured on Monday when two passenger trains collided in northern Italy, Italian police and fire service officials said.
Police said two trains run by a private company, Ferrovie Nord Milano, collided head-on in late morning on the Brescia-Edolo line northeast of Milan.
Firemen said four people were killed and at least 15 injured but information was still patchy with rescue efforts just getting under way.
Italian television said the occurred on a single-line section of track near a level crossing between the stations of Bornato and Borgonato.
Brescia is about 100 km (60 miles) east of Milan.
A railway company spokesman said the two trains were likely to have been packed with some 200 people given the current atrocious road conditions with many parts of Italy paralysed by heavy snowfalls.
Italian television said the cause of the crash was not yet known but frozen points was mentioned as a possible factor.
